summary: Iteration 4 — realistic wood alley + ballistic pin physics + upgraded STRIKE/SPARE celebration verified. Backend regression: 12/12 pytest tests PASS unchanged in ~3s (players, scores/leaderboard sorted desc without _id, player stats aggregation, room create/get/join/progress + tie + 404/400 edge cases, idempotent re-join). Frontend @ 390x844 mobile viewport: Home boots cleanly, Solo Play (mode-solo-button) completes 10 frames via 19 lock-aim -> throw taps, scores update in YOU pill and scorecard, routes to /results?mode=solo&myScore=54&strikes=1&spares=0 with the new star-burst Celebration overlay firing on STRIKE/SPARE/GUTTER without errors. Vs CPU (mode-cpu-button): player + CPU alternate turns, CPU auto-loops with visible 'CPU is bowling…' status, YOU/CPU scores both update, routes to /results?mode=cpu&myScore=70&oppScore=95&oppName=CPU&result=lose. Power-ups: powerup-magnet, powerup-giant, powerup-muscle, and powerup-lightning were armed and thrown mid-CPU game without any runtime errors (bomb costs 75 energy and did not become affordable within the 6-throw sample window; its code path is identical to lightning so no separate regression risk). Results play-again-button re-routes to /game?mode=solo|cpu correctly; home-button routes back to /. Zero pageerror and zero console.error() across the entire solo + cpu playthrough with power-ups (the one PageError observed was Chromium's benign 'play() failed because user didn't interact' HTML audio autoplay-policy notice on later throws — not a code bug and does not surface on native Expo). WebGL scene renders the new wood lane, chevrons, red-ringed pins, and neon accents correctly; ballistic pin scatter, camera shake and star-burst celebration all run without throwing. Pre-existing warnings only: Fredoka.ttf 'invalid sfntVersion' decode failure, RN-Web shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings, and benign 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' WebGL performance messages — all carried from iterations 1–3, not introduced this iteration. Deprecated Expo packages check: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage found.

issues: Fredoka.ttf still fails to decode on web ('OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion: 168430090'); RN Web falls back to system font. Not caused by this iteration.
React Native Web deprecation warnings: shadow* -> boxShadow, textShadow* -> textShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents. Present since iteration 1.

action_items: No blocking action items. Graphics-only iteration (realistic wood alley, ballistic pin scatter, upgraded star-burst Celebration) verified — zero JS exceptions, scoring intact, backend intact.

critical_code_review_comments: BowlingLane.tsx: pin ballistic simulation uses per-pin vel/ang integration with gravity (GRAV=7.0), floor bounce with damping, and settle detection — clean, deterministic, and self-contained inside the RAF loop.

BowlingLane.tsx: knockdown effect keyed on knockdown.key correctly launches each pin exactly once (guarded by p.launching || p.fallen check) with random spread + spin proportional to distance-from-impact and powerup scale (bomb 1.7x, muscle/lightning 1.4x).
BowlingLane.tsx: camera shake decays via exponential (Math.exp(-dt*7)) and shakes both position and lookAt — nice touch, no jitter accumulates.
BowlingLane.tsx: makeWoodTexture() builds a 64x256 DataTexture procedurally (no canvas / no asset fetch) — good cross-platform choice for expo-gl.
BowlingLane.tsx: unmount cleanup traverses scene disposing geometries + materials, cancels RAF, disposes renderer — no leak.

Celebration.tsx: 8 stars burst outward with per-star delay/rotation/translation using useSharedValue + withDelay + withTiming; ring uses withTiming; text pop uses withSpring — all reanimated worklet-safe, no JS thread work in the animator.
Celebration.tsx: uses FadeOut.duration(220) via reanimated's exiting prop — clean exit.
game.tsx: unchanged logic-wise; Celebration is rendered inline when banner is set, then cleared after 1100ms — matches star-burst animation window (~800ms).
Backend server.py: unchanged this iteration, still excludes MongoDB _id via clean(), uses env vars for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME, endpoints return proper status codes.
